status: Closed — batch checkpoint waiver forwarding repair and runner publication verified 2026-09-05
finding: `batch checkpoint` did not expose or forward `--waiver-out-of-scope-delivery` and `--emergency-approval` to the underlying `tasks close` call. A batch queue head with already-verified historical delivery commits that included necessary out-of-scope context could not close through the only legal batch checkpoint route.
expectedBehavior: Batch checkpoint should support the same explicit historical-delivery waiver and emergency approval controls as task close, and forward them unchanged to the close orchestrator. The route must remain explicit and auditable, not implicit.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-GIT-0026 had green evidence and historical delivery commits `91fcf80a5` and `dff658e7a`, but direct `taskflow close` was blocked by `ATM_BATCH_CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED`, while `batch checkpoint` was blocked by `ATM_TASK_CLOSE_DELIVERABLE_DIFF_REQUIRED` and did not accept the close waiver flags.
followUp: Repair landed in source commit `10e283f6250a684e884d8e92d3ab23e20af6f5d3` and runner publication `3269f80a5d704dea0c05645a787cc6f6e3b909aa`. Keep regression coverage for both long-form and alias waiver flags plus emergency approval forwarding.
